findings.description: Enemy-escape damage semantics were undocumented and could be mistaken for collision damage capped and suppressed by invulnerability.
findings.required_action: Resolved in the audited content commit; retain the cited validation and source invariant.
findings.resolution: Section 21.16 now specifies one penalty per escaped enemy, aggregation, the invulnerability boundary, and transition to GAME_OVER; end-to-end tests cover simultaneous escapes.
